description: Answers 'which financial MCP servers can I connect to - and which are healthy?' Give a search phrase q, optionally a category, a minimum grade (A-F) and a limit (1-50, default 10). Returns servers graded nightly by FinzData for health, protocol conformance and prompt-injection risk, with install URLs. Use get_mcp_server for one server's full listing.
name: search_mcp_servers
title: Search MCP Servers
